name: electremote
description: Control desktop media playback from another device on the same local network.

scripts.dev: corepack pnpm --filter @electremote/remote build && corepack pnpm --parallel --filter @electremote/remote --filter @electremote/desktop run dev:host
scripts.build: corepack pnpm --filter @electremote/remote build && corepack pnpm --filter @electremote/desktop build
scripts.package: corepack pnpm --filter @electremote/remote build && corepack pnpm --filter @electremote/desktop package
